description_en: Stops one or more nodes in a cluster
description_zh: 调用StopNodes停止集群中的一个或多个节点
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc stop-nodes --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --instance Id=i-bp13p7vlcb1uihf0000 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StopNodes

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The role of the nodes. Valid values:

Manager: management node
Login: logon node
Compute: compute node

Default value: Compute
parameters.help_zh:
节点角色。取值范围：
Manager：管控节点
Login：登录节点
Compute：计算节点

默认值：Compute
parameters.name: role

fields.help_en:
The ID of the Nth node to stop. N is an integer from 1 to 100.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87161.html
fields.help_zh:
第N个要停止的节点ID。N的取值范围：1~100

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87161.html获取节点ID
fields.name: id

parameters.help_en: The information about the nodes to stop
parameters.name: instance
